title: issueNewPassport
description: The request body of EP-ISSUE-NEW-PASSPORT: the new passport of a treated battery that is placed on the market again (section 10.2 of the implementation specification).

passportIdentifier.description: The passport identifier of the original passport.

catenaXId.description: The catenaXId of the twin of the original passport.

dataProviderBpnl.description: The Business Partner Number of the data provider of the original passport.

batteryIdentifier.description: The battery identifier of the original battery.

lifeCycleStage.description: The status of the original passport that the second-life operator read.

originalPurpose.description: The purpose for which the original battery was originally designed.

originalModelCatenaXId.description: The catenaXId of the original battery model of the original battery.

batteryModelId.description: The id of a battery model of the own company that references the original battery model: the 36 characters of a UUID.

batteryIdentifier.description: The battery identifier of the treated battery.

batteryCategory.description: The battery category of the new use.

facilityBpns.description: The Business Partner Number of the site of the treatment.

purpose.description: The purpose of the treated battery.

dateIntoService.description: The date of putting into service of the treated battery.

ratedCapacityAh.description: The rated capacity of the treated battery in Ah.

capacityFadePercent.description: The capacity fade of the treated battery in %.

powerFadePercent.description: The power fade of the treated battery in %.

expectedLifetimeYears.description: The expected lifetime of the treated battery in calendar years.

operationDate.description: The date and time of the operation; the current time of the clock when absent.

passportIdentifier.description: The passport identifier that the operator attributes to the new passport.
